title: Pathway-resolved analysis of internal conversion enabled by Gaussian boson sampling
summary: Gaussian Boson Sampling (GBS) has provided strong evidence of quantum advantage, motivating the search for real-world applications. Such applications rely on mapping physical problems to the native GBS output: photon-number patterns sampled from a highly non-trivial probability distribution. Here we derive a GBS-compatible mapping for the rate constant $k_\mathrm{IC}$ of internal conversion (IC), incorporating two important physical effects -- Duschinsky rotations and Herzberg--Teller contribution.
